entry_item.definition: [= zalm-a] n. Strips of material of five different colors tied to the manes of horses or to the necks of camels, bulls, rams, or goats consecrated to a deity, also to the tails of horses on certain festive occasions; they are also found on oboe ( see obuγ-a). See Mostaert, Dictionary 182 a. [Ko.] Five-colored strips of paper hung on the branches oi a tree planted in a vase used by shamans to call spirits.

example.definition: To use zalam-a in a shamanistic ritual intended to exorcise an evil spirit from a sick person.

entry_item.definition: une espèce de banderole de papier de cinq couleurs: elle se met sur un arbre ou bâton qu'on plante dans un vase.

example.definition: arborer une banderole de cinq couleurs

entry_item.definition: A streamer, a funeral flag. A piece of cloth or rope tied around the neckof an animal dedicated to the gods.
